text:
Priya S.: FYI AuroraEdge (FPGA partner) asked to run an EAP focused on low-power edge perf. NDA returned signed w/ minor redlines. They want a quick sync on bench scope and access model. Thoughts?

Anton M.: I can take infra onboarding. Question: will they provide container images or a custom runtime? Also need to confirm whether we can run our agent on their jump host or they prefer isolated test harness.

Daria L.: I'll own perf scope. Suggest we focus on: cold-start latency, on-device KV memory behavior, batch size scaling, and power draw under sustained load. Need sample workloads from product to mirror real queries.

Carlos P.: Legal flagged a clause about firmware screenshots. They want no screenshots of onboard firmware API. We'll request a carve-out for aggregated metrics + anonymized syslogs.

marketplace-bot: New partnership record created: aurora-edge-eap-2026. Link: https://partners.internal/aurora-edge-eap-2026

Priya S.: @Anton get the access details; @Daria gather 3 canonical workloads (chat short prompt, completion long prompt, embedding 512). @Carlos push legal ask to Aurora PM.

Anton M.: Aurora provided two access modes: (1) ssh to jumpbox with restricted SFTP, (2) OCI images pushed to their registry (requires short-lived creds). They prefer us to run inside their orchestration to capture power telemetry.

Daria L.: OK. For harness I'll add a power sampling thread (1s granularity) and a KV-cache eviction monitor. Proposed CLI: 

```
./run_edge_bench.sh --image aurora/redwood-edge:2026-01 \
  --workload chat_short --concurrency 4 --duration 600 \
  --power-sample 1 --output aggregated.json
```

We will NOT include any raw prompt data in aggregated.json (only token counts and latency histograms).

Carlos P.: Legal approved the aggregation exception as long as we redact raw inputs and keep only per-batch hashes + metrics. I'll attach the signed amendment to the NDA thread.

Priya S.: Timeline proposal: Day 0 access + smoke, Day 1 baseline runs (FP32 + int8), Day 3 quant sweep (4-bit if supported), Day 5 joint review with Aurora. Are we comfortable with that cadence?

Anton M.: Small snag: their cluster enforces a 45W cap per socket by default. We can request a temporary raise to 65W for throughput tests. I'll ask them and request a secondary rotated credential for long runs.

Daria L.: If we can't raise power, we should measure energy-per-token and include a note in the marketplace tile. That could be a feature.

Priya S.: @Aurora PM (cc'ed via partner-eng) please confirm whether the power cap can be adjusted and if we can get a non-prod rotated credential.

marketplace-bot: Partner-eng update: Aurora PM (Leona) replied via email: "We can provide rotated creds and temporary power bump for test window. Need dates and expected ramp."

Carlos P.: Attached amendment: aurora-nda-amendment-2026.pdf (internal). Key line: no firmware screenshots; aggregated telemetry only.

Anton M.: Access plan: use ephemeral OCI creds, pull their image, run on their orchestrator under a dedicated namespace. I'll provide a k8s manifest snippet: 

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
metadata:
  name: redwood-edge-bench
  namespace: aurora-eap
spec:
  containers:
  - name: bench
    image: aurora/redwood-edge:2026-01
    resources:
      limits:
        cpu: "8"
        memory: "32Gi"
```

Priya S.: Action items: Anton validate access + request power bump (owner: Anton), Daria publish harness + workloads (owner: Daria), Carlos attach signed amendment to the partnership record (owner: Carlos), Priya prepare a short marketplace draft if Day 5 review is positive (owner: Priya).

Daria L.: I'll publish the harness to https://git.internal/redwood/aurora-edge-bench and include targets.md (P50/P95/throughput/energy-per-token). Also adding a short runbook for partner runs.

Anton M.: Confirmed: got rotated creds and scheduled a 3-hour test window on Thursday. Will validate image pull and run a 10-min smoke earlier tomorrow.

Priya S.: Great. If any legal or telemetry issues pop up, tag @Carlos P. We'll keep this channel as the single-source-of-truth for the EAP.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: complete marketplace draft checklist before joint review. Checklist link: https://internal.marketplace/checklist/aurora-edge

Carlos P.: Legal sign-off complete and amendment attached to the partner record. Noted the firmware restriction.

Daria L.: First smoke run plan posted to the repo (scripts/smoke.sh). It will run small samples and upload aggregated.json to an S3 bucket with perms limited to partner-eng.

Priya S.: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the smoke and post baseline numbers here. :white_check_mark:
